question: Three out of the following four are alike in a particular pattern and hence form a group. Find the one which does not belong to that group.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06181392e9897efb4b81331befbf0235a23822489dcd574e6efffefb8787d3bd.png] 

Logic followed here is.

Logic: The groups are determined by the differences between the positional values of consecutive letters. Three groups follow a pattern starting with a decrease, while the odd group follows a constant increasing pattern.

Pattern of differences = 4 (-1) = 3; 3 (-1) = 2; 2 (+4) = 6

The pattern observed in WVWY, NMNP, and DCBF is an initial decrease (first letter > second letter).
